section_lead: With Next, the word goes up a cycle. If you get it right the first time, it's learned. No hidden dates or algorithms: you see which cycle each word is in and why.

stage_recognized_desc: Moved up twice. You should recognize it by now.
stage_frequent_desc: Moved up three times: it's the top cycle.

why_desc: You won't learn 5,000 words in a week. You'll learn what you need. And you'll remember them.
why_1_desc: In other apps, one mistake and the word is gone. Here it enters a cycle. Then another. Until it stays. No arbitrary intervals.
